title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: interactive UI widgets from MCP agents in US Government clouds
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts, licensing table and agent-blocking controls are supported. It correctly distinguishes the government's documented agent restrictions from the roadmap's planned widget support. The user-access default should retain Microsoft's qualification about existing app policies and user assignments.
